insight: User shifted from end-user applications to building the infrastructure layer due to agent fragility.

E2B PoC execution is only viable for: hardcoded secrets, SQL injection (string concat, no DB), path traversal (pure file ops), insecure deserialization. XSS/SSRF/auth bypass return UNVERIFIABLE without a live server. Narrow scanner prompts to PoC-executable categories only.
subprocess.run with shell=True + string-interpolated repo_url is RCE. Always use list form and validate repo_url starts with https://github.com/ before any subprocess call.

Never stack @observe() (Langfuse) and @DBOS.step() on the same function. DBOS uses function name/module for step identification; Langfuse wrapping changes these, causing silent replay failures. Apply @observe() to inner LLM helper functions only.

DBOS step replay returns cached path strings but does not re-execute step bodies. For filesystem state: compute tmpdir from job_id deterministically in workflow (not from step output), and add re-clone guard in every step that reads the filesystem.
connector.test() is sync and MCPNativeConnector.test() calls asyncio.run(); calling it directly in an async FastAPI endpoint raises RuntimeError. Wrap in await asyncio.to_thread().
skill_store.save_skill built a path from an LLM-supplied name with only space/hyphen replacement, allowing ../ and absolute-path escape from SKILLS_DIR. Slug with os.path.basename + regex allowlist.
AgentMesh consolidation should keep ui/ canonical, treat ui-next as a behavioral donor, and normalize Express agent routes plus NestJS Conductor routes behind one typed UI contract.
